<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Disable a job/client/schedule.

## Synopsis

```text
disable [job=<job>] [client=<client>] [schedule=<schedule>]
        [storage=<storage>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Switches a job, client or schedule off. A disabled job is no longer started by its schedule, a disabled client is no longer backed up, a disabled schedule triggers no jobs. A disabled job can still be started by hand with run. Without an argument, or with job, client or schedule without a value, the Director offers the enabled resources of that kind.

The change lives only in the memory of the running Director until the next reload or restart. A permanent setting requires Enabled = no in the configuration.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Job name. |
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name. |
| `schedule=` | resource | from [`.schedule`](../dot-schedule/) |  |  | Schedule name. |
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |

## Examples

Stop scheduled runs of BackupClient1 until the next reload:

```text
disable job=BackupClient1
```

Skip the client during maintenance:

```text
disable client=bareos-fd
```

Suspend a schedule:

```text
disable schedule=WeeklyCycle
```
